title: Choose the visual world for Realhive Blog
question: Your colors stay fixed (lavender ground, blue-800 accent, white surfaces). The roll assigned The Card Catalog. Keep it, take the pick, or re-roll.

options.label: The Card Catalog
options.lineage: library card catalogs: subject drawers, guide cards, filed index cards
options.thesis: Browsing the blog is browsing a catalog: subjects are drawers, posts are filed cards, filters are filing rules.
materials: white index card stock with a blue ruled header line
guide-card tabs standing above the row
options.viewport: Masthead, then a row of subject guide tabs (categories) with the active drawer raised; the latest posts filed as index cards with a ruled header, call label (category + date), title, excerpt.
options.risk: Turns twee if cards get fake typewriter fonts or paper textures; the card is a structure, not a costume.

raised.raise: Every card, tab and gap locks to one 8px module; nothing is spaced by eye.
State is a mark, not a hue: saved posts carry a folded corner flag, the active drawer tab is raised.
Rank comes from type scale and position; no boxes inside boxes, the reading column is never enclosed.

options.label: The Whiteprint
options.lineage: diazo whiteprints and engineering title blocks
options.thesis: Your lavender and blue already are a blueprint: every post is a drawing sheet with a title block.
materials: faint construction grid on the ground
options.viewport: Ground carries a faint drafting grid; posts are sheets with a title block (title, author, category, date as fields).
options.risk: Engineering-blog blueprint is the familiar move for dev content; heavy grids compete with photography.

options.label: Modular Identity Bars
options.thesis: Photos snapped under saturated bars on one module.
options.viewport: Photo panels overrun by colored bars.
options.case: Its four saturated primaries break your pinned palette; readers lose the article to the bars.
options.risk: Palette conflict with a binding brand commitment.
options.kept: One module that every element snaps to.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: Sections strung as frames on a perforated rail.
options.case: A tool costume for a reading surface; the rail would replace navigation readers already know.
options.kept: State as a mark: saved flag, raised active tab.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.thesis: Rank as depth on a black void.
options.case: Bitmap running text fails long-form reading.
options.risk: Dark void conflicts with the lavender ground.
options.kept: Rank by type, never by nested boxes.

options.label: Calavera Broadside
options.thesis: Image band over two hard columns.
options.viewport: Shouting headline, engraving band, two columns.
options.case: Folk satire tone misreads a consultancy's engineering writing.
options.kept: A firm image band above the text on post pages.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.thesis: One vertical depth axis rules the page.
options.case: No product truth maps to depth; readers would scroll a metaphor.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.kept: Precise alignment of every label to its anchor.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern tech blog: hero, featured grid, post cards, sidebar filters.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a reader expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other dev blog by design.

answer.via: structured question tool after the decision page closed unanswered (exit 4)
